system.description:
LEVEL 3

Deepening Study. Choose the Ice or Radiant school to learn.

Creature of the Fey. You may cast spells while Beastshifted.

Attuned to Nature. (WIL/Safe Rest) Add LVL to any skill check related to nature or weather.

LEVEL 7

Raging Tempest. Whenever you crit with a spell, you may cast a cantrip for free from a school you haven't cast any spells from this turn.

LEVEL 11

Primordial Force. (1/round) Your tiered spells grant an additional effect:

• Ice. Gain WIL temp HP.

• Lightning. Deal additional WIL damage.

• Radiant. (Reach 6) Heal a creature WIL HP.

• Wind. Fly up to 6 spaces for free.

LEVEL 15

Master of Storm. You can concentrate on 1 lightning spell and 1 wind spell at the same time. (1/encounter) When you would cast a tiered spell, it costs 1 fewer action and 3 fewer mana.
